ttl.name: ABS with EBD & TRC & VSC & BA System

s-1.ptxt: Brake System Indicator Light Initial Check

s2.ptxt: Check that the ABS warning light, brake warning light and slip indicator light come on and go off after approximately 3 seconds.

atten4.ptxt: If a light does not come on, check for a burnt-out bulb and inspect the communication line between the skid control computer (built into the actuator) and the meter.

s3.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3 and start the engine.
Turn on the SST power and select "Menu (Diagnosis)" → "Chassis" → "ABS/VSC" → "Active Test".

atten3.ptxt: To protect the motor, do not operate the motor for 5 seconds or more. When operating it continuously, allow an interval of 20 seconds or more.

s3.ptxt: Turn the motor relay ON and check the motor operating sound.
Keep the brake pedal depressed with a constant force for 15 seconds and check the brake pedal condition.
With the brake pedal depressed, turn the motor relay ON and check the brake pedal condition.
Turn the motor relay OFF and release the brake pedal.

item.ptxt: To protect the motor and solenoids, do not operate the motor and solenoids for 5 seconds or more. When operating it continuously, allow an interval of 20 seconds or more.
The Active Test operating time for each solenoid is approximately 2 seconds, after which it turns OFF automatically.
Do not depress the brake pedal with only the pressure reduction valve operating by itself.
Do not turn ON any solenoid other than those instructed.

s3.ptxt: Depress the brake pedal and hold it.
Turn the SFRH and SFRR solenoids ON at the same time and check the brake pedal condition.
Check the brake pedal condition when the SFRH and SFRR solenoids turn OFF.
Turn the motor relay ON and check the brake pedal condition.
Check the solenoids for the other wheels in the same way.

atten4.ptxt: Front right (SFRH, SFRR), front left (SFLH, SFLR), rear right (SRRH, SRRR), rear left (SRLH, SRLR)
